This position requires a highly skilled professional with expertise in infrastructure architecture, cloud systems, MSP tools, and automation. The successful candidate will act as a critical escalation point for the internal helpdesk team while driving innovation through scripting, automation, and tool integrations. Additionally, this role includes responsibilities related to backup infrastructure architecture, deployment, verification, and remediation escalation, specifically utilizing Veeam as the backup solution.  Job Responsibilities Escalation and Support Serve as the escalation point for complex issues unresolved by the internal helpdesk team. Act as an escalation point for backup remediation, ensuring critical data recovery and system integrity. Onboarding and Offboarding Oversee internal user onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure a seamless experience. Manage client onboarding and offboarding, ensuring all systems, accounts, and configurations are properly set up or decommissioned. Infrastructure Architecture and Maintenance Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot datacenter and cloud infrastructure, focusing on Windows and Azure environments. Develop and maintain backup infrastructure architecture using Veeam to ensure reliable data protection and recovery. Backup Management Design, deploy, and maintain Veeam backup solutions for internal and client environments. Perform regular backup verification with Veeam to ensure integrity and recoverability of data. Escalate and remediate backup failures, ensuring minimal downtime and data loss. Optimize Veeam backup policies and strategies for efficiency, compliance, and security. RMM (Remote Monitoring and Management) Maintain and troubleshoot the ConnectWise Automate platform. Develop and optimize RMM scripts and automation workflows to improve efficiency and reduce manual tasks. MDM (Mobile Device Management) Maintain and troubleshoot Addigy and Intune platforms. Create and manage MDM scripting and automation solutions to streamline mobile device management. PSA (Professional Services Automation) Maintain and troubleshoot ConnectWise Manage to ensure smooth operation of service delivery workflows. Tool Integration and Management Conduct proof-of-concept evaluations for new MSP tools. Integrate tools within the MSP environment to enhance operational efficiency. Patching Management Architect and maintain Windows and third-party patching processes to ensure compliance and security. Documentation Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for infrastructure, tools, and processes. Document Veeam backup configurations, verification processes, and remediation procedures. Job Qualifications Education and Experience Relevant Microsoft certifications Networking certifications advantageous 3+ years of experience in a similar role within an MSP environment Technical Skills Expertise in Windows Server, Azure infrastructure, and cloud technologies. Proficiency with RMM tools (ConnectWise Automate) and PSA platforms (ConnectWise Manage). Strong scripting skills in PowerShell or similar languages. Experience with MDM platforms (Addigy, Intune). Familiarity with MSP tools and their integrations. Experience with database platforms (MSSQL, MySQL). Adept at networking (Cisco, HPE, Dell, SonicWall, FortiGate). Strong understanding of backup infrastructure architecture, deployment, and verification using Veeam. Experience with Veeam backup solutions and troubleshooting backup failures. Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Detail-oriented with a focus on process improvement. Skilled in documentation. Job Requirements A home office set up that meets the following: Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following: Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or macOS 12 or newer. Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 5 Mbps download and upload speeds. Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings. Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app. Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls. 2nd Monitor  UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) if using a desktop (Not needed if using a laptop) A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview)  Excellent command of the English language both spoken and written  Able to work full time 40 hours a week -  8:00AM to 5:00PM, Pacific Standard Time (PST) from Monday to Friday. Able to pass our online behavior and cognitive assessments.  Preferably have at least 2 of the following certifications: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, 3cx Basic Certified Engineer. Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants). Compensation Pay rate starts at  $13.00/hr  and may vary by experience and location. Benefits Comprehensive Health Plans / HMO (Employee & Dependent/s) Life Insurance Flexible Benefit Reimbursement (Dental/Vision/Mental Health/Wellness/Government Contributions) Paid Time Off (starts at 15 days per year) Maternity/Paternity Leave Paid US Holiday Night Shift Bonus Salary Advancement/Loan Health & Wellness Program Company-paid training and certification

review_candidates.title: Sr. Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Join Us as Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer! ORBCOMM is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure that powers our global business and customer-facing platforms. In this role, you will play a key part in advancing cloud modernization, automation, platform reliability, and operational excellence across our multi-cloud environments. Why You’ll Love Working Here As a member of our Information Technology & Security team, you will partner closely with application, database, security, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable and secure cloud-native solutions that support enterprise operations and customer experiences. Based in Hyderabad, India, you will contribute to the evolution of ORBCOMM’s cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), helping drive scalability, resiliency, and innovation across the organization. This position is based in our Hyderabad office and will be working an onsite work schedule. What You’ll Do Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments. Develop scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant infrastructure solutions. Support enterprise and customer-facing applications with a focus on security, performance, and reliability. Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver cloud-native infrastructure and platform services. Lead cloud modernization initiatives and infrastructure migration projects. Scalability & Performance Optimization Design infrastructure capable of supporting business growth and increasing workload demands. Perform capacity planning and develop long-term infrastructure scaling strategies. Implement load balancing, auto-scaling, high-availability, and disaster recovery solutions. Conduct performance analysis across cloud and hybrid environments. Proactively identify and address infrastructure bottlenecks before they impact production systems. Automation & Infrastructure as Code Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code ( IaC ) solutions using Terraform and related automation tools. Automate provisioning, deployment, patching, and configuration management processes. Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve CI/CD pipeline efficiency and deployment reliability. Establish standardized, repeatable cloud infrastructure deployment patterns and best practices. Reliability, Monitoring & Operations Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions across cloud platforms. Support incident response, service restoration, and root cause analysis activities. Drive continuous improvements in infrastructure resiliency, recoverability, and operational maturity. Participate in on-call support and escalation processes as required. Security & Compliance Apply cloud security best practices across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments. Implement identity and access management controls, network security measures, and vulnerability remediation processes. Support compliance initiatives, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other applicable frameworks. Partner with security teams to ensure infrastructure aligns with organizational security standards. Who You Are You are an experienced cloud infrastructure professional who thrives in complex, high-growth environments. You bring deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, and infrastructure engineering, along with a passion for building scalable, reliable, and secure systems that support business-critical workloads. If You Have Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or cloud engineering roles. 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise cloud environments. Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Experience implementing and supporting large-scale, highly available, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Proven success designing systems that support business growth, high transaction volumes, or global user bases. Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, load balancing, routing, and firewalls. Experience administering both Windows and Linux environments. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. Experience with monitoring, observability, and operational monitoring platforms. Preferred Experience working in multi-cloud environments utilizing two or more of the following: Azure, AWS, and OCI. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or other containerized technologies. Azure and/or AWS cloud certifications. Experience supporting SaaS platforms and distributed applications. Experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks. Knowledge of cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices. Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity strategies. Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy. Then we want to meet you! The Benefits Of Working Here A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally. How We Hire ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture. About Us At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at www.orbcomm.com ! Ready to Join Us? We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

Desirable: Financial services experience, PowerShell, Terraform, ITIL Foundation or relevant Microsoft/security/networking certifications. What's on offer? £65,000 - £75,000 + benefits Hybrid working Global technology environment Exposure to modern cloud and infrastructure technologies Strong career progression opportunities
